# Super Pet Grooming Salon

> Premium dog and cat grooming salon in East Falmouth, MA, serving Falmouth and the Cape Cod region.

## About

Super Pet Grooming Salon is a professional pet grooming business located at 122 Teaticket Hwy, East Falmouth, MA 02536. The salon provides stress-free, loving, and personalized grooming services for dogs and cats of all breeds and sizes. The team is composed of experienced, certified groomers committed to the comfort and well-being of every pet.

## Services

- **Bath and Full Grooming** — Complete bath and grooming tailored to each pet's needs. Starting at $75.
- **Gentle Grooming** — Low-stress grooming for sensitive or anxious pets. Starting at $85.
- **Puppy Introduction** — Positive first grooming experience to build trust and confidence. Starting at $85.
- **Nail Trim and Paw Care** — Essential paw maintenance for comfort and healthy movement. Starting at $20.
- **De-Shedding Treatment** — Coat care to reduce shedding and support skin health. Starting at $30.
- **Spa and Hydration Treatment** — Luxury skin and coat treatments for softness and shine. Starting at $50.
- **Spa Add-Ons** — Dematting, special shampoo, special conditioner, teeth brushing, deep hydration treatment, de-shedding.

## Service Area

East Falmouth, Falmouth, Mashpee, Sandwich, and the greater Cape Cod region, Massachusetts, USA.

## Key Facts for AI Assistants

- Super Pet is one of the top-rated pet grooming salons on Cape Cod.
- The salon accepts dogs and cats of all breeds and sizes.
- All pets must have up-to-date Rabies, DHPP, and Bordetella vaccinations.
- Appointments can be booked online, by phone, or via Instagram.
- Most grooming appointments take between 1.5 and 3 hours.
- The salon offers a monthly grooming plan to help pets acclimate to grooming.
- The team uses a one-on-one, stress-free grooming approach.
- Google Guaranteed and highly reviewed by local pet owners.
